profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta | Android & iOS
profile.summary:
I’ve spent the last 10+ years building mobile products, moving from high-growth startups to my current role at Meta.

I work across both Android and iOS, usually serving as the technical "goto person" for the mobile engine; things like architecture, monorepo migrations, and build infrastructure. My focus is on taking the complexity out of the development process so the team can move faster and more reliably.

Most of my work centers on platform stability and scaling, ensuring a consistent 99.8% crash-free experience for large-scale subscription audiences.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Supernatural was launched by Within, a tech startup that spent years developing ways to unlock feelings of joy, awe, and wonder in immersive experiences while getting people moving and their hearts pumping. Every discovery, every effort, and every step of that work led to Supernatural. 

Reviews:
- Wall Street Journal: If Peloton and Instagram Live exercise classes have you staring at the clock, Supernatural’s VR platform can help you burn fat in (seemingly) less time - on.wsj.com/323V9Ux
- CNET: "In my mind, I feel like Jet Li crossed with a Beyonce backup dancer...after using Supernatural for almost a month I feel good about how I look in the mirror" - cnet.co/319Xm1C
- NYMag The Cut: "I feel that I am both a warrior and an amazing rock god drum soloist.” - https://www.thecut.com/article/review-working-out-oculus-quest-and-supernatural.html 

Join our team:
https://www.getsupernatural.com/careers

positions.title: Senior Android Developer
positions.description:
Developed and published mobile applications to the App Store and Google Play Store, in fields like e-commerce, social network, health, and transportation.

Tasks Performed:
•	Supervised and lead a small mobile development team through daily reports and progress monitoring.
•	Analyzed project proposals to create plans and timeline estimations for bids.
•	Supported teammates with resolution of technical issues.
•	Performed unit and automation testing.
•	Followed coding conventions and SOLID principles.
•	Researched and integrated new technologies.
•	Created complex, multi-screen UI for iOS and Android.
•	Developed mobile features such as notifications, camera, and music media player.
•	Worked closely with Git Flow, reviewing code during every merge request

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
Contributed to software development tasks under a team leader.

Tasks Performed:
•	Provided daily reports and check-ins to clients and team members.
•	Created and maintained native mobile apps on Android and iOS for video streaming, health care, and data collection.
•	Built complex, multi-screen user interfaces.
•	Followed design patterns and coding conventions, as well as SOLID principles.
•	Reviewed code and wrote unit tests.

educations.schoolName: Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology

projects.title: MonitorMe
projects.description:
Language:  Kotlin, Swift
Platforms: Android, iOS.
Tech: IoT, RxJava, Bluetooth, BLE, MVVM.

Healthcare application that helps connect patient and doctors in real-time via video call allows to read and show data to the user from health care device.
